title: ThemeParkRaters Modpack
description: A performance-boosted, beautiful modpack for building the ultimate theme park! Features Macaw's furniture suite, Iris shaders, Sodium optimization, Waystones, and Xaero's maps for seamless building and exploring.
body:
🎢 Welcome to ThemeParkRaters Modpack!
Whether you are building the ultimate amusement park, exploring sprawling custom landscapes, or just looking for a highly optimized, beautiful Minecraft experience, ThemeParkRaters Modpack has everything you need.

This pack is carefully curated to combine stunning visuals, massive performance boosts, seamless multiplayer utilities, and immersion-breaking details—all while staying lightweight and stable.

🚀 Ultimate Performance & Visuals
Powered by the best optimization mods available, enjoy buttery-smooth frame rates even with heavy builds:
Sodium & Sodium Extra + Lithium: Maximum FPS boosts and server-side optimization.
Iris Shaders: Built-in shader support to make your theme parks look breathtaking.
Continuity & 3D Skin Layers: For connected textures and enhanced player models.
Zoomify: Easily zoom in to inspect your detailed builds from afar.

🪑 Unrivaled Building & Decoration
Bring your creations to life with an extensive library of custom blocks and furniture:
Macaw's Mega Suite: A massive collection adding custom Bridges, Doors, Fences, Walls, Furniture, Lights, Lamps, Paths, Pavings, Roofs, Stairs, and Trapdoors.
Cooking for Blockheads & Farmer's Delight: Build fully functional restaurants, food stalls, and kitchens for your park guests.

🗺️ Exploration & Quality of Life
Navigating your world and managing your park has never been easier:
Xaero's Minimap & World Map: Never lose track of your builds or your friends.
Waystones: Set up fast-travel networks between different themed lands in your park.
Traveler's Backpack & Tool Belt: Keep your inventory organized while building on the go.
VeinMiner & RightClickHarvest: Speed up resource gathering and farming chores.
JEI (Just Enough Items) & Jade: Quickly look up recipes and see exactly what block you are looking at.

🎭 Atmosphere & Audio Immersion
AmbientSounds & Cool Rain: Rich, dynamic background audio that breathes life into your world.
Incendium & Lithostitched: Explore completely overhauled, breathtaking nether environments and world generation.
Chat Animation & Chat Heads: Makes multiplayer interactions feel much more alive and personal.
